metadata.title: PAMP Suisse Lunar Legend Series | Bullion Trading LLC

description: A review of PAMP Suisse’s Lunar Legend series, comparing it to the prior Lunar Calendar line and highlighting design, themes, and collector appeal.
text:
When PAMP Suisse announced their new Lunar Legend Series in 2024, I’ll admit I was intrigued. After twelve years of their successful Lunar Calendar Series (2012-2023), what could they possibly add to the lunar-themed bullion market? But after seeing the 2024 Legend of the Azure Dragon release and now the 2025 Legend of the White Snake, I have to say – they’ve created something genuinely special here.
This isn’t just a continuation of their original lunar series. PAMP has taken their proven lunar concept and elevated it into something that works both as serious bullion and as collectible art through the power of storytelling. And from what I’ve seen in the market, investors are responding positively to both aspects.
Building on Twelve Years of Success
PAMP’s relationship with lunar-themed precious metals goes back to 2012, when they launched their original Lunar Calendar Series with the Year of the Dragon. That series ran successfully through 2023, completing a full 12-year zodiac cycle and establishing PAMP as a leader in themed bullion.
1 oz Gold Bar – PAMP Suisse Year of the Rabbit
But rather than simply restart the cycle with basic zodiac imagery, PAMP made a brilliant decision for 2024: they launched an entirely new series focused on the legendary stories behind each animal. This new Lunar Legend Series doesn’t just celebrate the zodiac animals – it tells the mythological tales that gave these creatures their significance in Chinese culture.
What Makes the Lunar Legend Series Different
Most lunar-themed precious metals, including PAMP’s own original series, focus on celebrating the zodiac animals themselves. The new Legend Series takes a fundamentally different approach – they’re telling the actual legends behind each animal. This series of minted bullion bars not only celebrate each Lunar New Year, but dive deep into the legendary stories that define each of the 12 animals of the Chinese Zodiac.
The storytelling element is what sets this new series apart from both competitors and PAMP’s own previous lunar offerings. Instead of just showing a dragon or snake, they’re depicting the mythological tales that gave these animals their significance in Chinese culture. It’s a more sophisticated approach that appeals to collectors who want substance behind the artistry, while building on the proven success of PAMP’s lunar-themed bullion.
The 2024 Legend of the Azure Dragon: A Strong New Beginning
The new Legend Series launched with the 2024 Legend of the Azure Dragon, and PAMP chose their subject well to kick off this second-generation lunar series. As guardian of the east, the Azure Dragon is a harbinger of the coming spring season, and is said to control rain, essential for bountiful harvests.
The reverse side exhibits the revered Azure Dragon of the East, a symbol of power and nobility, with the Chinese character for “Dragon.” The design work shows clear evolution from the original 2012-2023 series – you can see the attention to detail that PAMP developed over twelve years of lunar designs, but now enhanced with deeper storytelling elements that don’t overwhelm the bar’s investment appeal.
2024 1 oz Gold Bar PAMP – Legend of the Azure Dragon
What impressed me most about the Legend of the Azure Dragon release was how it differentiated itself from the completed 2012-2023 series while maintaining PAMP’s established reputation in lunar bullion. These bars have maintained strong premiums and liquidity, suggesting that the market was ready for this storytelling evolution.
2025 Legend of the White Snake: The Story Deepens
The 2025 release tells the legend of the White Snake, and this is where PAMP’s new storytelling approach really shines compared to their previous lunar work. After a thousand years of Taoist training, the white snake Bai Suzhen was granted the power to become a human woman. She then searched for Xu Xian to repay him for his bravery that saved her in a past life.
It’s a tale of love, sacrifice, and redemption that gives the 2025 bars genuine cultural depth beyond what was possible with the simpler zodiac imagery of the original series. The obverse features an exquisitely detailed depiction of the White Snake, a legendary figure in Chinese mythology, symbolizing wisdom, transformation, and prosperity.
2025 1 oz Gold Bar PAMP – Legend of the White Snake Goddess
The design execution on the Legend of the White Snake shows PAMP’s design team hitting their stride with this new storytelling concept, building on over a decade of lunar design experience.
Technical Specifications That Matter
The Legend Series maintains PAMP’s usual high standards while incorporating lessons learned from twelve years of lunar production:
Purity
: .9999 fine gold – as pure as investment gold gets.
Sizes Available
: The series comes in multiple sizes to suit different budgets:
5-gram bars (perfect for smaller investments)
1-ounce bars (the sweet spot for most investors)
Available in both gold and silver versions
Packaging
: Comes in a tamper-evident red CertiPAMP assay card, which is crucial for authenticity verification and resale value.
Thickness
: 1.73 mm for the 1-ounce bars, making them substantial enough to feel valuable but not so thick they’re unwieldy.
Investment vs. Collectible Value: Learning from the Past
Here’s where PAMP’s experience with the original 2012-2023 series really shows. These new Legend bars straddle the line between investment bullion and collectible pieces even more successfully than their predecessors.
On the investment side, they’re .9999 pure gold from one of the world’s most respected refiners. The PAMP name alone ensures liquidity – any dealer will recognize and accept these bars immediately, just as they did with the original lunar series.
On the collectible side, the storytelling element creates additional appeal beyond what the original series achieved. Early indications suggest that the Legend series bars may hold premiums even better than the original lunar series, though it’s still early to make definitive comparisons.
Pricing and Value Considerations
The Lunar Legend Series carries a higher premium than standard PAMP bars, which you’d expect given the artistic elements and limited production. From current market observations:
5-gram bars typically run around $640-$660 depending on gold prices
1-ounce bars are generally priced in the $3,500-$3,600 range (subject to gold market fluctuations)
Compared to the original 2012-2023 series during its run, these premiums are slightly higher but reasonable given the enhanced storytelling elements. The question is whether that premium is worth it. In my experience, if you’re buying purely for gold content, you can find better value elsewhere. But if you appreciate the evolution from basic zodiac imagery to rich cultural storytelling, the premiums are justified for what you get.
Who Should Consider These Bars
The Lunar Legend Series works best for investors who:
Appreciated the original 2012-2023 lunar series but want more depth
Value cultural storytelling and enhanced artistic design
Want something more sophisticated than the previous generation of lunar bullion
Are building themed collections and want to participate in PAMP’s second lunar cycle
Don’t mind paying moderate premiums for storytelling uniqueness
Plan to hold for medium to long term (the collectible aspect needs time to develop)
They’re less suitable if you were satisfied with the simpler original lunar designs or if you’re looking for the lowest-premium gold possible.
Looking Ahead: The Second 12-Year Journey
PAMP appears committed to telling all 12 zodiac legends over the coming years in this new format, which would mean this Legend series could run through 2035. That’s building on their proven track record of completing the original 12-year cycle from 2012-2023.
For collectors, this presents an interesting opportunity – you can start the second cycle while potentially still acquiring pieces from the completed first cycle. For investors, it means each year’s design will have its own legendary character and story, potentially creating different levels of demand and collectible value than the original series achieved.
My Take on the Evolution
Having followed PAMP’s lunar offerings since the original 2012 launch, I’ve been impressed by how thoughtfully they’ve evolved the concept. The Lunar Legend Series manages to be both a natural progression from their successful original series and a meaningful enhancement that justifies its existence.
The 2024 Legend of the Azure Dragon successfully established this new direction, and the 2025 Legend of the White Snake has built on that foundation while showing clear differentiation from the simpler zodiac approach of 2012-2023. If they maintain this storytelling quality across the full 12-year cycle, this could become even more significant than their already successful original series.
The premiums are reasonable for the enhanced cultural content you’re getting, the legendary stories add genuine depth beyond basic zodiac symbolism, and PAMP’s proven track record with lunar themes ensures these will always be liquid. It’s a solid evolution for investors who want their gold to tell richer stories.
The Bottom Line
The PAMP Suisse Lunar Legend Series represents a successful evolution of themed precious metals – building on twelve years of proven lunar success while adding storytelling depth that justifies a new series. The cultural storytelling element adds layers that go far beyond the decoration of the original 2012-2023 series, and PAMP’s execution quality benefits from over a decade of lunar design experience.
As we wait to see what legend PAMP will tell for 2026, one thing is clear – they’ve successfully evolved their lunar concept to honor both the past and the present, wrapped in the world’s most trusted precious metal and backed by twelve years of lunar series success.
Whether you collected the original 2012-2023 series or you’re drawn to this new generation’s deeper storytelling, these Legend bars offer a way to own investment-grade gold while participating in an enhanced version of ancient storytelling traditions. At Bullion Trading LLC, we stock both the current 2025 Legend of the White Snake and the 2024 Legend of the Azure Dragon bars for investors interested in starting their journey with this evolved lunar series.
